svg.title: DreamCarve phase 4 wireframe: Profile editor
svg.text: 05 · Operation editor, Profile, every group open (capabilities 66–69). Field names are the file's; labels are the chapters'.
Identity · Targets · Tool · Depth · Strategy · Entry
and leads · Corners and tabs · Order · Heights. A
group with no field for the kind is not shown. Open
Step-down, stepover and pitch show the tool's value
as grey placeholder text and write null. ⟲ clears
? beside a label shows the chapter's one-sentence
definition on hover. Labels are the chapters' names;
the file's field name is in the tooltip.
A warning check locates at a field shows under that
field, in the warning colour, as well as in the
Hovering the group highlights the targets on the
Viewport. Pick… lets the user click shapes until
The request (count or distances, size, shape, on
holes, avoid corners) is the file's tabs field.
Place tabs runs tabs place and the request becomes
placed tabs on the part (ADR-0005), listed in the
Design Tree and draggable on the Viewport (08).
Nothing the generator ignores for this kind appears;
nothing it reads is hidden. Acceptance test 73
checks the table in capability 68 against the
